blockdesc-generatorconsole-*: Place it facing the spot where the generator should stand: the tower rises eight blocks behind it, over a shaft sunk deep into the rock. Deliver materials here to raise each stage. Breaking the console abandons the project.
stagedesc-shaft: A lined shaft sunk into warm rock, with a foundation collar at its mouth. Everything above will stand on it, and everything the generator draws will come up through it.
stagedesc-valves: The main riser and its heavy gate valves. They bleed surges from the deep off into relief ports, so the pressure stays inside what the machine can bear.
stagedesc-pumps: Four pump towers that drive surface water down the injection lines, to where the rock turns it into superheated steam.
stagedesc-core: The vessel where rising steam is split through the distribution header into working lines, for pumps, light, heat and industry.
stagedesc-frame-a: A riveted portal frame that takes the load of the upper works. The generator needs two, set crosswise.
stagedesc-frame-b: The second portal frame, set across the first. Together they carry the hull and the stack.
stagedesc-hull: An insulating steel shell around the core. It throws heat back inward and lets the operators decide how much of it escapes.
console-allcomplete: Generator: {0} complete. The generator is ready to be fired.
console-ready: The generator is complete and cold.
console-fired: The core catches. The generator is running.
console-banked: The core is banked. The generator goes cold.
console-tooshallow: This site is too close to the bottom of the world. The console needs to stand at height {0} or above.
